description: Source code for a SwiftUI view named DebugSettings, which provides a comprehensive debug and diagnostic interface for the OpenClaw macOS application. It includes UI elements for gateway management, logs, port diagnostics, file paths, quick actions, and canvas debugging functionalities.

classes.name: PlainSettingsGroupBoxStyle
classes.description: Custom SwiftUI GroupBoxStyle for consistent styling of setting sections.

classes.name: DebugSettings_Previews
classes.description: SwiftUI preview provider for DebugSettings view during development.
